STABLE RELEASE CHANGELOG

What’s new

Stable release history from the first public version to the latest release. Changes are documented separately for every version; beta-only features are excluded.

STABLE 28 October 2026

CurveMole 1.1.0

Added

  • Add reversible Stable and Beta update channels with a visible installed-beta indicator. Switching back to Stable does not downgrade an installed beta. (90f7c2b6)
  • Open files from the operating system in a single desktop instance and import multiple files through the batch mapping dialog. (ea3c4cde)
  • Add guided Calculator sections, selected-spectra operations, and a Restore RAW data control. Extend function initialization with Add/Delete/Move points, live previews, Undo support and coordinate-aware point selection. (56f33d11)
  • Configure function options, initial parameters and bounds before adding a component to a model. (f3d9c4ba)
  • Add function point editing and workspace keyboard shortcuts, including more commands accessible with simple, context-aware keys. (dbc8a656)

Changed

  • Reduce startup work and initial memory use with lazy scientific-backend imports, plugin loading after the first window paint, and reused plot items during Overlay and Waterfall redraws. (82494ca1)
  • Improve the scientific task lifecycle and rendering architecture with explicit fit/render controllers, bounded worker queues, state restoration, and rate-limited rendering diagnostics. (6dfce6d5)
  • Support explicit promotion of a tested beta snapshot to Stable, maintaining a separate release channel and stable source-version metadata. (b3f5e052)

Fixed

  • Preserve peak shapes when editing function control points and reapply edited recorded background subtraction as a single reversible operation. (12ff4187)
  • Prevent shortcut collisions and stale saved assignments: reserve preferred bindings before restoring user choices, release keys from removed commands, and normalize shifted punctuation without intercepting text entry. (6f324f68, 084f49ae, b153f94c)
  • Prevent a Windows file-opening race by preserving the named-pipe connection until the forwarded file request receives its acknowledgement. (992ee78b)
  • Keep function-placement instructions readable at larger font sizes and avoid misplaced point gestures on small or high-DPI screens. (88397a75)
  • Address the 11 scientific audit findings: preserve convolution grids; validate grouped removals; restore analysis records after Undo; invalidate linked and global fits after model edits; maintain consistent covariance, metadata, point-editor links, bounds and workflow identities. (6dfce6d5)

Earlier stable releases

STABLE25 October 2026

CurveMole 1.0.1

Fixed

  • Reduce startup work on all platforms by loading pandas only when needed for data import or export. Windows installations now keep their dependencies unpacked, avoiding extraction on every launch while retaining the installation path, shortcuts, settings and existing projects. Portable Windows downloads retain their single-executable format for compatibility with existing updaters.

Known limitations

  • A Windows portable executable named exactly CurveMole.exe may not reopen automatically after an in-app update. If it stays closed, double-click the executable to start the updated application; settings and projects are preserved. The installer and versioned portable filename passed the tested upgrade paths.
Official release ↗Compare with previous stable ↗
FIRST STABLE23 October 2026

CurveMole 1.0.0

Changed

  • Publish CurveMole 1.0.0 as the stable release. Align the manual, Quick Start, README and website with the current application and its stable status. Update notifications identify the available version and classify its first changed number as a bugfix, feature release or major update.
  • Export a complete analysis bundle by default, including the spectra, function parameters and current-view figures also available as Quick export commands. Add a named destination subfolder and a detailed README while retaining export ownership checks. Give every curve its own styled Matplotlib PNG/SVG/PDF and a separate summary-PDF page. Replace the repetitive Python tidy table with keyed observation/component tables, curve metadata and a ready-to-run replot script.
  • Group related bundle choices together and keep all figure exports adjacent. Separate PNG, SVG and PDF figures into format subfolders, including current-view figures. Start the export README with a readable file-and-folder contents table and retain the exact machine-readable inventory in manifest.json.
